dialogue.text: Hi! Let's count in base eight. We call it octal.
Octal uses eight digits, from zero through seven.
We'll read each digit from left to right.
This says one, two. Its value is ten.
My sign shows the decimal value.
Each place to the left is worth eight times as much.
Now let's start our count at zero.
One more makes a new place.
The next number has three digits.
We reached one seven seven in octal!

timing.gap_boundary: End of the last digit clip to the start of the next digit clip
